documentation.subject: Vote CLT: ballot lookup failed
documentation.content:
The `lookupAddress` Cloud Function logged an ERROR. Usually `outcome: upstream_error`: the Mecklenburg BOE search could not be reached or returned an unexpected page (e.g. a Cloudflare block), so voters cannot see their sample ballot. `outcome: internal` is a bug in our code.

**Look:** [lookup outcomes, last 24h](https://console.cloud.google.com/logs/query;query=resource.type%3D%22cloud_run_revision%22%20AND%20resource.labels.service_name%3D%22lookupaddress%22%20AND%20jsonPayload.message%3D%22lookup%20outcome%22;duration=P1D?project=vote-clt) — `jsonPayload.detail` has the error.

**Then:** `make functions-lookup-prod ADDR="3227 Planters Ridge Rd 28270"`. If the BOE is blocking ScrapingBee, try `SCRAPINGBEE_PROXY_MODE=stealth` (see CLAUDE.md, Gotchas).

At most one email per 30 minutes; the incident closes itself after 30 quiet minutes.
